ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated in a solid V-shape at the peduncle base and scattered as discrete, high-contrast mottling along the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography with frequent small-amplitude serrations and several larger, distinct notches, particularly on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep of both lobes; trailing edges exhibit a concave curvature from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of small, circular dark pixel clusters (likely pigment spots or barnacle scars) distributed across the white field, most prominent on the right lobe distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged wear and potential minor amputation at the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive large dark patch/blob on the right lobe approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip, extending toward the trailing edge.
